countGroup.Name_As_Printed: Mr. S. H. B. Allison Barr

source.title: Derry Journal, 21 May 1952, p. 2 ("County and rural council nominations: four contests in Limavady"); Londonderry Sentinel, 22 May 1952, p. 2 ("3 critical contests for Unionists in Limavady R.D.")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: 'Mr. William Selfridge ... did not seek re-election, and for his seat in Ballykelly, which adjoins Drumreighland division, Mr. Barr was nominated and was returned unopposed' (Derry Journal 21 May 1952 p2; Londonderry Sentinel 22 May 1952 p2).

note: Triennial election of the 23 electoral divisions of Limavady rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Twenty-seven candidates were nominated and four divisions were contested; the Nationalists gained two seats and with them control of the council. Sixteen of the nineteen unopposed members added from the nominations report (Derry Journal, 21 May 1952, p. 2; Londonderry Sentinel, 22 May 1952, p. 2): Ballykelly as the report gives it, the rest from their divisions at the 1949 return. Aghanloo, Feeny and The Highlands (W. J. Thompson, James O'Kane, John Alcorn) are held, as for 1949 (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
